# 2. `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/new_topic.md`

Ye tab use hoga jab koi contributor bole ki **kisi language me ek important topic missing hai**.

```md
---
name: 📚 New Learning Topic
about: Suggest a new programming concept or topic
title: "[Topic]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## 📚 Programming Language

Which programming language should this topic be added to?

Example:

```text
Python
Ruby
C++
Java
R
